extracted.name: Harvard Beets
extracted.description: Vinegar is a great complement to beets. In this recipe beets are simmered with vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and salt.
instruction_lines: Drain the beet liquid into a medium saucepan. To the liquid add vinegar, sugar, cornstarch and salt. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium; stir in beets and cook until heated through.
